traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied. The valid-annotation-format rule’s helpers now detect non-traceability JSDoc tags generically (any '@tag' other than @story/@req/@supports) and treat them as boundaries, terminating multi-line traceability values and preventing concatenation of subsequent JSDoc content into story/req values. Continuation lines are only appended when they do not start with another JSDoc tag. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts explicitly cover traceability annotations before other tags, after other tags, mixed positions, multi-line annotations preceding JSDoc tags, and the specific bug scenario where '@param' content used to pollute the requirement ID. All these tests pass in the latest Jest run. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md has a dedicated JSDoc coexistence section with examples referencing this story, explaining the new behavior and the removal of the prior workaround. Existing annotation validation behavior and other stories’ requirements remain covered by passing tests, indicating backward compatibility and no regressions. Therefore the story is fully implemented.
